name: Python Application
description: Minimal production Python HTTP application with health endpoint.

files.content:
"""Minimal production HTTP application provisioned by DigiPanel. The entry point uses only the Python standard library so the application can start without a package installation step. Replace this module with the real application and keep the health endpoint for process supervision. """ from __future__ import annotations import json import os from datetime import datetime, timezone from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer HOST = os.environ.get("HOST", "127.0.0.1") PORT = int(os.environ.get("PORT", "8080")) APP_URL = os.environ.get("APP_URL", f"http://{HOST}:{PORT}") STARTED_AT = datetime.now(timezone.utc) class ApplicationHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): server_version = "DigiPanelApp/1.0" def do_GET(self) -> None: # noqa: N802 if self.path == "/healthz": self._send_json(200, {"status": "ok", "uptimeSeconds": int((datetime.now(timezone.utc) - STARTED_AT).total_seconds())}) return if self.path in ("/", "/index.html"): body = ( "\n\n" "" "Application ready\n" "\n" "

Application ready

\n" "

This Python application was provisioned by DigiPanel.

\n" f"
Public URL
{APP_URL}
" f"
Process started
{STARTED_AT.isoformat()}
" f"
Python
{os.sys.version.split()[0]}
\n" "

Replace app.py with your application. Process supervision is managed from Runtimes & Apps.

\n" "\n\n" ) self._send_text(200, "text/html; charset=utf-8", body) return self._send_text(404, "text/plain; charset=utf-8", "not found\n") def _send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None: self._send_text(status, "application/json; charset=utf-8", json.dumps(payload)) def _send_text(self, status: int, content_type: str, body: str) -> None: encoded = body.encode("utf-8") self.send_response(status) self.send_header("content-type", content_type) self.send_header("content-length", str(len(encoded))) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(encoded) def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args: object) -> None: print(f"{self.address_string()} {fmt % args}", flush=True) def main() -> None: server = ThreadingHTTPServer((HOST, PORT), ApplicationHandler) print(f"listening on http://{HOST}:{PORT}", flush=True) try: server.serve_forever() except KeyboardInterrupt: pass finally: server.server_close() if __name__ == "__main__": main()
# No third-party dependencies required by the generated application.
